def prompt_begin(self, seq, pos_start):
        state = self.states[seq]
        # An explicit prompt_begin is the only request boundary, for any
        # absolute start position.  Reset this sequence only -- another slot
        # may be prompting or generating right now.  Drain stale queued jobs
        # from the interrupted request before the buffers are reused, then
        # clear the per-request progress and failure flags.
        state.drained_positions.extend(state.queued_positions)
        state.queued_positions.clear()
        state.mode = "prompt_absolute"
        state.prompt_start = pos_start
        state.verify_rows = 0
        state.failed = False

def cancel(self, seq):
        # Cancel is scoped to this sequence: discard its still-queued work and
        # every per-request flag so the slot is reusable, leaving all other
        # sequences untouched.
        state = self.states[seq]
        state.queued_positions.clear()
        state.drained_positions.clear()
        state.verify_rows = 0
        state.failed = False
        state.mode = "idle"
